tmp:2980: the act of raising up fallen faith (emunah nefulah) from the husks of false beliefs/idolatry — the elevation from which converts are made

tmp:2984: the act of burnishing one's neshamah — refining the soul via joining Godly spirituality to the constriction (sharing God's Name in one's distress)

tmp:2988: chibbur — the joining/union of divine spirituality with the physical body and the tzimtzum, defined as the very essence of creation
tmp:2989: beri'ah chadashah — the new creation now effected by uniting divine spirituality with body and constriction
tmp:2990: the doubling and multiplication of livelihood (parnassah nikhpelet) — as in 'whoever joins Heaven's Name to his distress, his livelihood is doubled'
tmp:2992: hamshakhah — the act of drawing down divine spirituality (ruchaniyut Elokut) into tzimtzumim/constrictions-bodies, the Shaddai-mode of divine indwelling

tmp:2994: the act of drawing up and revealing the deep waters, i.e., the counsels (eitzot) hidden in the heart — work of the ish tevunot (Prov. 20:5)

tmp:2999: the state of being rectified and receiving healing for the 'wondrous blows' (makkot mufla'ot) — cure of the incurable wounds via restored faith
tmp:3001: the restorative return whereby all the aforementioned aspects (faith, rain, herbs, healing) are rectified again through revealed counsels
tmp:3002: eitzot revealed in the world — counsels made publicly known so each person can counsel his own soul, the source from which faith grows

tmp:3004: zekhut avot — the merit of the Patriarchs becoming revealed (an effect of restored faith/counsel)
tmp:3006: the healing power possessed by herbs — their capacity to cure, conferred by their faith-ordained seasonal-spatial order

tmp:3008: the specific order herbs have according to time and place — the temporal-spatial arrangement of growth that gives medicinal potency
